items.ruling_applied: manual §1 S6 / §3.1 rule 3; R1 by analogy
items.reason: The question is radiotherapy fractionation ('compare conventional radiotherapy of 60 Gy (6 weeks) versus hypofractionated radiotherapy of 40 Gy'). Temozolomide is identical in both arms ('concurrent (75 mg/m2/day qd) and adjuvant (6 cycles)'), so it is soc_backbone and not an established-therapy experiment. R1 ties established_therapy_only to an established drug that is itself the subject (rule 6), which is not the case here. The manual does not define the three S6 reasons, so established_therapy_only (the only drug is an established GBM therapy) is also defensible.

note: XL convention needed: which S6 reason applies when the only drug is a soc_backbone established therapy and the experimental variable is radiotherapy? The choice affects only Figure 1 labelling. Separately, both coders coded MGMT as eligibility for 'known o6-methylguanine-DNA-methyltransferase promoter methylation status'. This requires a known status, not a specific one, and other coders have coded the same wording exploratory_correlative (e.g. NCT04552977). If XL decides a known-status requirement is not selection, any_molecular_selection here becomes false.
